prioritized_defects.description: The policy-rejection path is modeled as rejecting the requests themselves, while the requirement says the mediator must not pass service requirements to the local PA when requests are unacceptable by provider policies.
prioritized_defects.evidence: R126 says: 'If the user requests can not be accepted according the provider policies, service requirements are not passed to the local PA.' The diagram instead routes the 'no' branch from 'Requests acceptable by policy?' to 'Reject requests' and then to 'Request rejected', which changes the stated behavior from withholding service requirements to rejecting the requests.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Revise the branch so it models non-passing of service requirements to the local PA, or rename/retarget the path only if rejection of the requests is explicitly intended by the requirement.

prioritized_defects.description: Requirement R139 is not traced to any diagram element.
prioritized_defects.evidence: If a peered CDN provider refuses to accept user requests, a given peering arrangement ceases.
prioritized_defects.suggested_action: Add or connect a diagram element representing this requirement.

final_recommendation: Prioritize the semantic mismatch in R126 first because it affects behavior, then address the missing traceability for R139.
